genre_archetype: veterinary triage and recovery routing ranch
camera_perspective: three-quarter top-down pasture clinic board with readable animal paths and station drop zones
control_model: tap animals to inspect, drag animal cards to care stations, tap treatment cards to queue treatments, tap completed stations to release
core_loop_signature: receive animals with visible conditions, diagnose needs, match treatment cards to stations, manage station queues and stress, release recovered animals, earn trust and upgrade clinic capacity
differentiation_axes: diagnosis and treatment sequencing are the primary decisions instead of feed recipe matching
animal stress and waiting lane overflow create time pressure
station queues create routing decisions distinct from pen adjacency or crop stall stocking
recovery ratings reward correct care order and low-stress completion
UI uses bottom treatment card tray, intake lane, and station rack instead of cookbook and delivery clipboard
forbidden_template_reuse: do not copy Meadow Snack Ranch feed recipe matching or product quality order loop
do not copy Pasture Parade Deluxe adjacency combo pen maintenance loop
do not copy Market Morning Farm crop stall pricing and customer queue loop
do not reduce the game to a single generic animal pen
do not use animals as circles, rectangles, or label-only placeholders
do not reuse the cow feed bowl icon composition

map_content_budget.play_area_model: fixed landscape pasture clinic board with intake path, central care stations, and recovery exit flow
map_content_budget.camera_or_scroll_model: fixed board with no scrolling for core play; overlays must use reserved zones

primary_player_actions: drag animal to matching care station
collect recovered animal at release gate
special_rules: each animal can hold one or two condition tags
wrong treatment raises stress and wastes station time
waiting lane overflow causes animals to leave stressed
excellent recovery requires correct treatment and low waiting time
rare visitors require two-stage care for bonus rewards
risk_reward_systems: treat urgent animals first for trust or treat easy animals for fast throughput
spend rare medicine on high-value visitors or save it for later waves
queue multiple animals at one station but risk waiting lane pressure
failure_pressure_variants: shift timer expires below trust target
medicine stock runs out during urgent wave

primary_game_art_packs: license-clear semi-realistic farm animal sprites with readable quadruped and bird silhouettes
asset_variety_budget.ui_pack: skin_cartoon_light with custom clinic card tray and station sign refinements
asset_variety_budget.animation_tier: delivery-ready animal idle, worried, treatment, recovering, happy, excellent, and stressed states
asset_variety_budget.asset_reuse_note: animal art may reuse approved ranch animal packs only when silhouettes, state markers, and treatment feedback clearly support veterinary care rather than generic feeding
